posts.name: Katsue
posts.cooked:
McBehrer:

I'd say there are plenty. Any in which the heroes need to build up,

If the Heroes want to build up, then you want to play it first turn so that you don't end up wiping your own board after you've built up.

 

McBehrer:

or if there are things that happen LATER that are worse than what they start with (Voss with his airships, Akash'Bhuta, Omnitron, Gloomweaver, The Chairman, The Matriarch, Spite (don't want to kill victims!), Miss Information, The Vengeance Villains, The Dreamer, Kismet) and it's useless against The Ennead.

Against many of those Villains I would play it first turn. The Vengeful 5 I would definitely play it first turn, because they start off with so much nasty stuff that would be a pain to leave on the table. Against Miss Information, you have a consequence free way of killing the first Distraction. Against The Dreamer you are skipping the whole first half of the game, which can be very dangerous indeed. It's definitely a first turn play against Gloomweaver, since you can't use it to kill his Relics, so you may as well use it to kill his Zombies.
